title: Failure bits for the confidence parameter
statement: For every natural number $n$, if the confidence parameter is $1/(20(n+1))$ and the number of failure bits at parameter $\delta$ is $\operatorname{clog}_2\lceil 2/\delta\rceil$, then that number is $\operatorname{clog}_2(40(n+1))$.
